_comment: Maps GitHub usernames (lowercase, as they appear in PR author fields) to Slack member IDs, so the release notifier can @-mention the right person in Slack. A GitHub username not listed here just gets shown as plain text instead of a broken mention -- missing entries never break the notification.
_how_to_find_a_slack_id: In Slack, click the person's name/avatar -> the '...' (more) menu on their profile card -> 'Copy member ID'. It looks like U01ABCDEF2.
